**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 10.3, p0063).**

- **What the document says:** Section 10.3 is a bare successors-and-assigns provision with no consent standard for either party. There is no change-of-control clause anywhere (searches for "change of control", "merger", "transfer" returned nothing relevant), and HDI's termination rights (p0024, p0026) are notice/payment-based only.
- **Direction check:** Our assignment freedom is not restricted and HDI has no CoC exit or re-pricing right, so the walk-away triggers are absent and I did not flag anything that benefits us.
- **Why it still fails the fallback:** The fallback requires consent (not unreasonably withheld) for non-successor assignments. As drafted, HDI may freely transfer this hosting arrangement — including access to Company data and the licensed "Deerskin" marks (p0038) — to any third party, including a Company competitor.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** minimal addition to 10.3 giving the Company express affiliate/M&A-successor assignment freedom, imposing a reasonable-consent gate plus no-competitor limit on HDI, and confirming a Company change of control gives HDI no termination, suspension or re-pricing right. The comment offers the mutual notice-plus-reasonable-consent fallback.
